# Home
## Elect Benny Lee for Oro Loma Sanitary District Board District 3
Thank you again for trusting in my leadership for bringing policy experience and positive changes to Oro Loma Sanitary District as your elected Director. I continue to hear from many of you to understand the issues we face today and how our policies can pave way to a better tomorrow.
Fiscal responsibility continues to be a top priority while investing in our staff and infrastructure to ensure services have no disruption for you, our customers. Climate change has proved to be a growing threat with climate events that will challenge our infrastructure as it has shown in the past few years; however, Oro Loma Sanitary District has led in replacing our aged sewer infrastructure with state-of-the-art newer pipes that have cut unplanned service calls and promises reliability for our long-term future. Our policy decisions are constantly focused on making the district more resilient, which provides for best-in-class services that ultimately keeps our environment clean and healthy.
The sciences that guide Oro Loma Sanitary District will continue to move us to a better tomorrow and I am committed to policies that will keep our environment clean and healthy for you and future generations.
Please elect Benny Lee for Oro Loma Sanitary District – District 3 2026.
Benny Lee
Director, Oro Loma Sanitary District Board
